title: UninitializedPropertyAccessException on a lateinit field of a service: component scan does not see the collaborator
errorSample:
kotlin.UninitializedPropertyAccessException: lateinit property discountPolicy has not been initialized
    at task.PriceQuoteService.getDiscountPolicy(Application.kt:26)
    at task.PriceQuoteService.quote(Application.kt:29)
    at task.PriceQuoteServiceTests.일반 회원은 할인이 없다(PriceQuoteServiceTests.kt:21)
symptom: A service that declares a lateinit var collaborator throws kotlin.UninitializedPropertyAccessException on first use, although the context starts without errors.
cause: The collaborator class is not picked up by component scanning, so there is no bean to assign to the property and it remains uninitialized.
fixSummary: Add @ComponentScan(basePackages = ["task"]) next to @SpringBootApplication on the application class so that the collaborator package is scanned and the bean is registered and assigned to the field.
